name: rsmeans_2020
note: Published RSMeans index numbers transcribed from the reference sections of the two 2020 books in the reference corpus (docs/review_2026-10-15/COST_INDICES.md). Reference data only: no client data. Released files are immutable (basis/data/cost_indices/manifest.json): to change a value, add the next file and its manifest entry.

historical_cost_index.book: Building Construction Costs with RSMeans data, 2020 (Gordian)
historical_cost_index.definition: The table lists the RSMeans historical cost index (Jan. 1, 1993 = 100) and, for each year, the computed index based on Jan. 1, 2020 = 100. Time adjustment: Index for Year A / Index for Year B x Cost in Year B = Cost in Year A (p.778). One value per year: July 1 of the year, and Jan. 1 for 2020, the book's estimate for its own cost basis (space is left to write in the actual quarterly figures).

cost_basis.note: the 2020 books' unit costs are U.S. national averages as of Jan. 1, 2020 (Residential p.11, 'All costs represent U.S. national averages'); the Jan. 1, 2020 index is the book's estimate

location_factors.basis: The costs in the book are national averages; 'to adjust these costs to a specific location, simply multiply the base cost by the factor for that city. The data is arranged alphabetically by state and postal zip code numbers' (p.718). The factor is the City Cost Index's weighted-average row for the city divided by 100 (p.287: 'The last row of data in the CCI, the weighted average, is the same as the numbers reported for each location in the location factor table'; the CCI is a ratio to the 30 major city average = 100 as of July 1, 2019, Building p.779).
location_factors.rule_for_unlisted: For a city not listed, use the factor for a nearby city with similar economic characteristics (p.718). The product's state-level factor is the arithmetic mean of the state's listed cities, rounded to three decimals, recorded as such on every cost row.
location_factors.excluded: Guam (969, 1.34), Puerto Rico (009, .68) and the Canadian factors (in Canadian dollars) are in the book and not transcribed: no state code in the intake selects them.
